  while  running the seccomp check of zbx doctor
  cause  the seccomp check could not run: prctl(PR_GET_SECCOMP) failed: this
         kernel does not support it (ENOSYS)
  kernel 6.8.0-45-generic
  fix    see how this kernel was built:   grep -E 'CONFIG_SECCOMP(_FILTER)?=' /boot/config-$(uname -r)
         use a kernel built with CONFIG_SECCOMP=y
